description: Check whether a password hash appears in the Have I Been Pwned breach corpus using k-anonymity: the caller sends only the first five hex characters of a SHA-1 hash, so no password or full hash ever leaves the caller. Returns the matching hash range, or a breach count when an optional suffix is supplied. Price: 0.005 USDC. Mode: live_source. Source: Have I Been Pwned Pwned Passwords range API. Set auto_pay=true for a one-call purchase when the local buyer wallet is configured.

auto_pay.description: Automatically authorize and pay this request with the locally configured buyer wallet. Requires X402_AUTO_PAY=true and X402_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.

payment_id.description: payment_id returned by the x402 invoice.

payment_signature.description: Base64 x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE produced by a compatible buyer client.

prefix.description: First 5 hex characters of the SHA-1 hash of the password to check. Only this prefix is sent upstream.

preview.description: Inspect a rate-limited live contract proof showing source, freshness, response shape, and required inputs. Decision-ready values remain in the paid result.

suffix.description: Optional remaining 35 hex characters of the SHA-1 hash. When supplied, the response reports a direct breach count instead of the full range.

tx_hash.description: Base transaction hash after paying an x402 invoice.

name: pwned_check
